The clip captures his charismatic, free-spirited personality through expressive smiles and gestures, bathed in golden forest light. Dialogue: 'Never miss a shot when the light's like this.'

frames.text: Close-up portrait of a young man with wild curly auburn-red hair, bright smile showing teeth, freckled fair skin. Forest bokeh background with golden sunlight. Joyful, charismatic expression. This is the human half of the Sagittarius centaur character.

Same young man in slight three-quarter view, one hand raised in explanatory gesture. Arrows visible over shoulder. Warm, friendly expression with slight knowing smile. Backlit by golden forest light creating hair glow.

Portrait continuing with the red-haired man giving a subtle wink or squint, content smile. Freckles prominent on sun-touched skin. Natural charismatic presence suggesting the free-spirited Sagittarius personality.
